designEvaluation.accuracy: Core-derived XP progress, practice thresholds, allocation effects and resources. Current injured/exhausted resources are preserved. The learning and reward curves are game tuning rather than measured learning behavior.
designEvaluation.efficiency: Event-driven DOM; no RAF, renderer or framework. Existing pinned paints are reused. Full durable journal validation remains core-owned and bounded; no CPU benchmark is claimed.
designEvaluation.narrative: Subjective preference favors the existing green/brass field-record style, separate practice meters, a nonblocking level notice and banking by closing. New classes/species/perks are deferred.
designEvaluation.recommendation: Use this basic core-backed panel for the current character-development use case; game-specific useful-action eligibility, authenticated grants and adoption remain consumer responsibilities.

receipt.purpose: Basic character-development allocation and persistence acceptance
receipt.method: Supported Playwright browser close and HTTP close in finally
